items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I got a call from Louis Armstrong wanting me to come in right away.

ctx.x: But in the meantime I was still playing on weekends, you know, with Buck and different groups. I even went to (The Village Streamers) Toronto with the group that made 'Fiddler on the Roof.' It had this guy, Maranyi in it, Joe Maranyi. I went there with them.
Now, the funny thing, soon as I got in the Chase Manhattan, I got a call from Louis Armstrong wanting me to come in right away.
